title: Specific jurisdiction
summary: Specific jurisdiction is authority to decide a claim connected to the defendant’s forum contacts. It is claim-linked, so the relationship among defendant, forum, and litigation must be identified.
notes: A broad topic index collects the course’s relevant cases, including limiting cases and contrasting bases of jurisdiction.

sections.Meaning: Specific jurisdiction is authority to decide a claim connected to the defendant’s forum contacts. It is claim-linked, so the relationship among defendant, forum, and litigation must be identified.
sections.How to work through the question: Ask what the defendant deliberately did concerning the forum, how the claim arises out of or relates to that activity, and whether the exercise is reasonable under the applicable cases. Check the authorizing rule or statute as well.

priorAccount.title: Specific jurisdiction
